"""
∑_i α_i + 1/M ∑_i ∑_j (f(X_i,j)/`p_c`(X_i,j) - (∑_k α_k p_k X_i,j)/`p_c`(X_i,j))
        where
        α: ℝ^m
        p: ℝ^m
        X: ℝ^(m×n)
        M: ℝ
        f: ℝ -> ℝ
        `p_c`: ℝ -> ℝ 
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, α, p, X, M, f, p_c):
        α = np.asarray(α, dtype=np.float64)
        p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
        m = α.shape[0]
        n = X.shape[1]
        assert α.shape == (m,)
        assert p.shape == (m,)
        assert X.shape == (m, n)
        assert np.ndim(M) == 0
        sum_0 = 0
        for i in range(1, len(α)+1):
            sum_0 += α[i-1]
        sum_1 = 0
        for i in range(1, X.shape[0]+1):
            sum_2 = 0
            for j in range(1, X.shape[1]+1):
                sum_3 = 0
                for k in range(1, len(p)+1):
                    sum_3 += α[k-1] * p[k-1] * X[i-1, j-1]
                sum_2 += ((f(X[i-1, j-1])) / (p_c(X[i-1, j-1])) - ((sum_3)) / (p_c(X[i-1, j-1])))
            sum_1 += sum_2
        self.ret = sum_0 + (1) / (M) * sum_1
